KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

5. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

6. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Anga.

7. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   D. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.

8. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. pana
   C. fupi
   D. zito

9. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Huyo na Hao and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
